notes.title: May 23 Update: Game Flow, Chat, and Shop
notes.content:
We’re incredibly grateful for your support during Early Access! Every match you play and every bit of feedback helps shape the future of the game. 

[b]⚽ Game Flow and Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the AI match startup to a Yes/No that can be declined instead of automatically starting an AI bot match.
[*] Reduced Mercy Rule from a 7 to a 5 score difference, added UI that shows your victory through mercy ruling.
[*] Decreased Game time to 3 minutes.
[*] Reduced the velocity of Bunbot's kick by 50%, making them less likely to score.
[/list]
[b]💬 Chat[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed chat filtration. Common words should be protected now.
[*] Added chat spam prevention in the chat box by adding a timer.
[*] Fixed a bug causing chatbox to disable button inputs on the post game screen.
[/list]
[b]🛍️ Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Shop with better user experience for purchases.
[*] New items featured in the Shop, get them while they're here!
[/list]
[b] 🐛 Game Play Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that make the ability SFX and VFX loop during gameplay.
[*] Fixed a bug that let you use abilities during game start cinematic.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the sprinting camera shake getting stuck on your camera.
[*] Fixed emote wheel not selecting correct emotes.
[*] Other bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
More updates and new features are already in the works. Stay tuned and keep playing—we’re building this together!
— The Football Heroes League Team

notes.title: May 14 Update: Connectivity, Chat, and Leaderboard Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Message of the Day[/b]
[list]
[*] A rotating notice to keep you up to date on events, challenges, and more.
[/list]
[b]AI Fill for Solo Lobbies[/b]
[list]
[*] If no one joins your match within 1 minute, you’ll see a pop-up announcing AI players will be added in 90 seconds.
[*] Timer resets if real players join.
[*] AI-filled matches don’t affect rank—but you can still complete Quests and earn EXP.
[/list]
[b]Chat Disable Setting[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn in-game chat on or off at any time.
[/list]
[b]🔗 Account & Progress[/b]
[list]
[*] Linked Accounts now properly receive ranked points.
[*] Daily Free Heroes will reliably reset at your local 6 AM time.
[/list]
[b]🌐 Matchmaking & Connectivity[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded Regional Matchmaking: Broader search to nearby regions for faster matchmaking and more matches.
[*] Better Ping Determination: Smarter algorithms to pair you with servers offering the best connection.
[*] Relaxed Host-Migration Requirements: Reduced disconnects by easing criteria for when migrations occur.
[*] Connectivity Pop-up Moved: Issue notifications now appear neatly in the top-right corner.
[/list]
[b]📊 Leaderboards[/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic Positioning: Always see 10 players above and 10 below you—no matter where you rank.
[*] All Categories Visible: No more missing leaderboards; every stat and category shows up correctly.
[/list]
[b]🌍 Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Added full support for Turkish and Spanish (Latin America).
[/list]
[b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed over-zealous chat filter that was blocking valid messages.
[*] Weekly quests now correctly display hero names.
[*] Resolved issue where daily free-hero icons could grey out on rank changes.
[*] Camera inversion settings now save and apply correctly.
[*] Bun-E Defend Bot dome reticle size corrected for proper targeting.
[*] Chromatic aberration graphics setting now persists between sessions.
[*] VFX have been optimized for performance and stability.
[/list]

notes.title: May 6th Patch - Networking Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content:

[*] Fixed Frostine skinning bug.
[/list]
